requirements.label: 125 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Piano Performance requires a minimum of 125 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory core (Aural and Written Skills I-IV)
requirements.hint: THEORY 139, 149, 140, 150, 239, 249, 240, and 250. The aural and written skills sequences run across the first two years.

requirements.label: 400 level Theory elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Theory elective. THEORY 433 may count here or toward the junior and senior elective, not both.

requirements.label: Musicology core
requirements.hint: MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music, 140 History of U.S. Musics, 239 History of Music, and 240 History of Western Music.

requirements.label: 400 level Musicology, Theory, or listed Jazz elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Musicology or Theory elective, or JAZZ 460, 467, 470, or 479.

requirements.label: Ensembles (2 terms from the approved list)
requirements.hint: Two terms from the listed large ensembles.

requirements.label: Additional approved ensembles (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two additional terms of any approved ensemble beyond the two listed-ensemble terms.

requirements.label: ENS 181: Sightreading Skills (2 terms or proficiency)
requirements.hint: Two terms of ENS 181, or pass the proficiency. Students who receive proficiency must still elect 2 terms of an approved large or small ensemble.

requirements.label: ENS 481: Piano Accompanying (4 terms)
requirements.hint: Four terms of ENS 481, normally in the third and fourth years.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Private piano study every term, 24 credits total with completion of PIANO 440.

requirements.label: PIANO 460: Piano Forum (every term)
requirements.hint: One credit, elected each term of the program.

requirements.label: Additional music requirements
requirements.hint: PIANOLP 401 Piano Technology, CONDUCT 315 Elementary Conducting I, THEORY 211 Basic Keyboard Skills I, THEORY 433 Analysis of 20th Century Music, THEORY 442 18th Century Counterpoint, and PIANOLP 481, 482, 487, 488, and 489 (pedagogy and literature sequence).

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year, taken alongside PIANO 440.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.

requirements.label: Language: French, German, or Italian (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of French, German, or Italian.

requirements.label: French (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of French.

requirements.label: German (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of German.

requirements.label: Italian (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of Italian.
